request.task: Certify OBX-AUTH-R1-P1-SOLO-001 inside the complete wave-2 Release 1 governance change
request.head: 206d37c48604ca33fb364744a0c3c51a5b2c37ce

findings.scenario: Criterion (1) requires the first three scoped authorization records to remain byte-identical. This diff re-serializes ATF-001 compact arrays into multi-line arrays and re-serializes T02 nested binding objects from single-line form into pretty-printed objects. T01 appears untouched, but ATF and T02 are no longer byte-identical to 4b02f75. Canonical hashes can still match, so the parent verifier stays green while the freeze the criterion named is already broken; a later semantic edit can be hidden in the same reformatting noise.
findings.remediation: Restore ATF-001, T01, and T02 from BASE with no whitespace or key-layout change. Insert the R1 records after those three objects only. Pin the exact serialized bytes (or a raw-substring digest) of authorizations[0..2] in verify-plan-authority.mjs and fail if they differ from 4b02f75.

findings.scenario: Criterion (4) requires fail-closed enforcement of the freeze. The parent now only requires the first three IDs and order, plus ATF/T01/T02 canonical/self-hash checks. JSON.stringify of IDs and canonical-json-v1 both ignore the ATF/T02 pretty-print, and no test asserts byte identity against BASE. Result: the suite can pass (and this diff's new full-verifier test expects pass) while criterion (1) is already false.
findings.remediation: Add a focused test that copies authorizations[0..2] from the registry file and compares them to golden bytes taken from 4b02f75. Keep the existing canonical pins as a second oracle, not the only one.

findings.scenario: OBX-AUTH-R1-P2-SOLO-001 is recorded with implementationAuthorized true and predecessorBinding.status PENDING_PREDECESSOR_MERGE. validatePredecessorGate only checks pending shape (null checkpoint, file list, disjoint effects). It never emits predecessor-phase-not-merged, and the module never inspects the worktree, so a later P2 implementation diff can pass this verifier while the recorded activationPrecondition still forbids OBX-P210 child work. That is a grant the owner gated and the module claims to enforce.
findings.remediation: When status is PENDING_PREDECESSOR_MERGE, fail closed unless the current diff is governance-only (activationWriteSet). On any path outside that write set, or any P2 allowedPath change, emit predecessor-phase-not-merged. Add a node test that mutates a P2 allowedPath file while the binding is still pending and expects that invalidator.

audit.proof_assessment: Review is static against the supplied diff only. Proof artifacts were empty, so claimed SHA-256 values (P1 self-hash 60a23140…, amendment cc4fbde4…, without-packetDigest 8bbf07e6…, receipt targetHashes) were treated as pins the module rechecks, not as independent evidence they match the bytes in this slice. P1 record shape for criterion (3) matches the stated fields: single-file allowedPaths, closed allowedEffects, empty nonWaivableClassesTouched, governance/dependency bindings equal to T02's values, null predecessorBinding and activationPrecondition, 336-hour non-renewable window with effectiveExpiresAt 2026-09-14T13:33:33Z sourced from T01, canonical-json-v1 self-hash contract. Authority-manifest and this diff's ticket manifests do not set implementationAuthorized true. Receipts bind the manifest through canonical-json-v1 excluding /packetDigest, which is the right shape for criterion (5), but those hashes were not recomputed here.
residual_risks: validateEffectiveWindow returns without error if T01/T02 cannot be parsed; expiry is only enforced indirectly by validatePredecessorRegistryRecords and Date.now() vs recorded expiresAt, not vs effectiveExpiresAt.
verifyRelease1PhaseAuthorizations returns success when zero R1 records are present; absence removes the grant rather than creating one, but it will not fail a revert of this wave.
Amendments are not unknown-key rejected; extra fields cannot widen the registry grant but can look like authority to a human reader.
Effect strings are labels only; this module does not prove future P1 code stays inside isLocalApiAuthorized or the named effects.
Grok receipts are in activationWriteSet and requiredEvidencePaths but not in this slice; the module fails closed if they are missing, and they were not available to review for drift.
